    com.jasonwjones.pbcs.api.v3.SubstitutionVariable
    since 3.1.0. This is the wire format, which earlier versions exposed directly from PbcsApplication and PbcsPlanType. Use PbcsSubstitutionVariable and its subtypes instead. The library still uses it to talk to the server, but it won't be part of the public API in 4.0.

    this method is being phased out as AIF/interop calls are carved out of the core EPM cloud API
    com.jasonwjones.pbcs.client.PbcsApplication.getSubstitutionVariable(String)
    This returns the REST API's payload class, which won't be part of the public API in 4.0. Use PbcsApplication.getVariable(String). Note that it only returns a variable defined for the whole application, where this method returns the first variable of either scope with the name.
    com.jasonwjones.pbcs.client.PbcsApplication.getSubstitutionVariables()
    This returns the REST API's payload class, which won't be part of the public API in 4.0. Use PbcsApplication.getVariables(), which returns the same variables as PbcsSubstitutionVariables.
    com.jasonwjones.pbcs.client.PbcsApplication.updateSubstitutionVariable(String, String)
    Use PbcsApplication.updateVariable(String, String), which does the same; it's renamed to match the other substitution variable methods.
    com.jasonwjones.pbcs.client.PbcsApplication.updateSubstitutionVariables(Collection<SubstitutionVariable>)
    This takes the REST API's payload class, which won't be part of the public API in 4.0. Use PbcsApplication.updateVariables(Collection).
    com.jasonwjones.pbcs.client.PbcsPlanType.getSubstitutionVariables()
    This returns the REST API's payload class, which won't be part of the public API in 4.0. Use PbcsPlanType.getVariables(), which returns the same variables as PbcsPlanTypeSubstitutionVariables.
    com.jasonwjones.pbcs.client.sso.IDCSAuthCodeFlow.getAccessTokenFromAuthCode(String)
    IDCS authorization-code exchanges normally require the same redirect URI used when obtaining the code; use IDCSAuthCodeFlow.getAccessTokenFromAuthCode(String, String).
